hook_bindings.description: Add trace_writer.f90 and trace_hooks.f90 to refmac5 target only.
Import SUMSFS_LS_DERIV hook in ls_scaling_double.f.
Capture assigned SUMSFS_LS_DERIV scale/structure-factor terms when called from active LSQ_COEF row.
Import completeness diagnostic hooks in calc_completeness.
Emit completeness_begin call header before ASU loop.
Emit generated-ASU reflection row input in calc_completeness.
Capture every matching shell increment in calc_completeness (preserving all-match shell semantics).
Capture separate overall (NB1) observed/missing increment in calc_completeness.
Emit per-ASU-row terminal outcome in calc_completeness.
Emit completeness summary after harvest array assignments.
Emit mandatory completeness call end before deallocation.
Import normal termination wrapper in PROGRAM refmac5.
Close native diagnostic trace on normal refmac5 termination path only.
Import diagnostic hook procedures in LSQ_COEF.
Emit LSQ_COEF call header with conditionally guarded scale state and bounds.
Reset per-row trace-owned state at start of reflection loop iteration.
Capture per-row input state in LSQ_COEF with FREER(I) guarded by FREER_FLAG.
Capture operand state inside actual SO > 0 branch.
Capture matched shell J and pre-addition shell accumulators before sigma guard.
Capture post-addition shell accumulators, or latch call-wide invalidity if L3 did not run.
Capture overall (NB1) pre-addition state guarded by L3 and call validity.
Capture overall (NB1) post-addition state guarded by L3 and call validity.
Emit terminal per-row outcome in LSQ_COEF from trace-owned branch flags only.
Capture raw 2xNB1 sums/counts before statistics divide AFO/AFC into means.
Capture fresh work-partition division inside NREFA_this(1,I) > 0 branch.
Capture fresh free-partition division inside NREFA_this(2,I) > 0 branch.
Record RFACTOR_WORK carrier assignment guarded by current-call nrefa_this(1,NB1) > 0 and numeric validity.
Record RFACTOR_FREE carrier assignment separately from fresh L9_free division.
Emit mandatory LSQ_COEF call end record and clear active invocation state.
